title: Compute the graph, critical path and slack from the index, failing test first
goal: A pure function turns the index's steps into nodes, edges, the critical path and each node's slack
acceptance: Input is the cache's step rows; output is nodes (id, repo, title, lane, remaining hours, estimate, actual hours when closed, state, source link at its commit, slack, onCriticalPath, mustFollow and mustPrecede), edges and problems

Tests, committed failing first: a chain, a diamond (two paths, the longer is critical, the shorter has slack), two equal paths (both critical), a closed prerequisite (done, not scheduled), a step without an estimate (flagged), a cycle, an unknown reference and an unreadable repository (each a problem entry), a cross-repository edge
No dates and no probability anywhere in the output; actual hours are shown beside the estimate, never fed back into the estimate
Runs on the nine real checkouts without error and reports its size (nodes, edges, problems) in the step's evidence
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no personal data, tokens or private reports in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: One pure function over rows the index already holds (dependsOn, estimate, actual hours), plus tests for each edge case. Estimated 2026-11-27. Not a measurement.
